source_acquisition.search_note: PDF首页和附录 A 明确给出项目网站、代码仓库 https://github.com/Open-X-Humanoid/XR-1、HuggingFace 与 ModelScope 模型集合；reading/source inventory 的自动状态仍为 no_public_source_found。GitHub API 检查 main 递归树至 commit 0141fc6dfa835eb91a009e062b45ff52d7016b06：存在 README、assets/images 下的 overview/result 导出图和大量训练/部署代码，但没有 plot/figure/table/visual 生成脚本、notebook、TeX/TikZ/PGF、SVG 或样式参数文件。corpus/visual_sources/icml-2026-e390f6423d6a/ 不存在。导出图只能作为部分视觉参照，无法从源文件精确恢复 PDF 对象的字体、颜色、线宽或导出参数；因此状态为 partial_visual_source。未获取模型权重、checkpoint 或数据集。PDF 是对象清单与最终视觉事实源。

paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文图表使用柔和蓝、桃、绿、黄阶段/场景面板；结果条形图固定使用橙、绿、棕、黄、蓝、灰，并用白色斜线突出 XR-1；表格使用淡蓝表头和粗体结果。附录检索/t-SNE 图引入任务色与自然照片色。色彩与标签、纹理、分面共同承载语义，但多数照片和任务色不具备可靠灰度等价物。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Letter 双栏正文中，正文文字、表格线、坐标轴和公式主要由 PDF 字体/矢量对象构成；Figure 1–3、5、8、11–18 是照片、截图与示意组件的混合或栅格嵌入，Figure 4、6、7、9、10 的图内条形图以嵌入栅格为主，caption 仍为 PDF 文本。pdffonts 可见 Nimbus Roman、CMR/CMMI/CMSY、Calibri、Times New Roman、DengXian、CambriaMath、DejaVuSans 与 NimbusMono 等对象。
paper_style.style_consistency: 主文/附录均采用 Letter 双栏页面、对象下方 caption、页宽结果图和淡蓝表头；结果图在不同 embodiment 间保持同一方法色和条形语法。Figure 1/2 的彩色框架、Figure 3/5/11–18 的照片网格与表格的出版式线条形成可识别的视觉语言，但图内字体来源混杂、密集标签偏小，附录长表的续页导航也不够强。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. We introduce X Robotic Model 1 (XR-1), a versatile and scalable vision-language-action framework. XR-1 supports robust multi-task learning across diverse robot embodiments and environments.

color.semantic_mapping: Green, blue, and yellow panels separate framework, embodiments, and task/evaluation roles; radar hues identify methods; photos carry natural scene color.

encodings.color: pastel panel role and method identity in the radar chart
encodings.shape: photo card, rounded panel, radar polygon
encodings.line: arrows from datasets through framework to evaluation cards; radar spokes
encodings.facet: datasets, framework, six embodiments, and five evaluation claims
encodings.text: dataset names, method labels, robot names, and evaluation headings

figures.data_and_statistics: The figure is an architectural and qualitative overview rather than a single statistical chart. It shows four pretraining sources, six robot-embodiment photos, a six-method radar inset, and illustrative task cards; the radar values are point success rates with no denominator or uncertainty shown in the figure.
figures.evidence_relation: Links the abstract claim of a versatile cross-embodiment VLA to Figure 2’s three-stage mechanism, Figure 3’s setup, and Figures 4–7’s quantitative tests.
design_strengths: The central framework gives the page a clear visual anchor and a left-to-right causal reading order.
Dataset, mechanism, embodiment, and evaluation cards let a reader recover the paper scope before reading the method.
design_weaknesses: The density of photos, arrows, labels, and radar marks makes small labels hard to read at page scale.
Natural-image color and the radar palette do not preserve all method distinctions in grayscale; the caption states the broad claim but does not define radar axes or values.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a central system interface with source, mechanism, embodiment, and evaluation cards when a paper must establish scope in one opening visual.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. Overview of X Robotic Model 1 (XR-1). In XR-1, we introduce the Unified Vision-Motion Codes (UVMC), a discrete latent representation that jointly encodes visual dynamics and robotic motion. XR-1 adopts a three-stage training paradigm to enable precise low-level control across diverse robots and tasks.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue, peach, and lavender backgrounds separate stages; green and orange arrows mark information flow and reconstruction.

encodings.color: stage identity and modality (vision, motion, action)
encodings.shape: rounded module box, dashed input/output frame
encodings.line: solid and dashed directional arrows between stages
encodings.facet: Stage-1 code learning, Stage-2 UVMC-guided pretraining, Stage-3 deployment post-training
encodings.text: stage titles, modality labels, token names, losses, and input/output labels

figures.data_and_statistics: No quantitative marks or uncertainty are encoded. The visual specifies the information flow and names the codebook, reconstruction outputs, VLM, action head, UVMC-aware learnable token, and MSE/action losses.
figures.evidence_relation: Instantiates the abstract XR-1 claim in Figure 1 and supplies the mechanism interface referenced by the method equations and the ablations in Tables 3 and 14.
design_strengths: The three-stage grouping makes the training order and modality bridge inspectable.
Input/output labels and arrows expose where UVMC enters policy learning.
design_weaknesses: The diagram contains many tiny labels and several crossing arrows near the codebook.
The caption names UVMC but leaves token placement, arrow semantics, and loss scope to the graphic.
figures.reusable_pattern: Represent a multi-stage multimodal method with a top-level pipeline and parallel lower-stage training lanes.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3. Experimental Setup. We evaluate XR-1 across six robot embodiments (Tien Kung 1.0/2.0, Single-/Dual-Arm UR-5e, Dual-Arm Franka, and AgileX Cobot Magic 2.0), covering more than 120 manipulation tasks with over 14k rollouts.

color.semantic_mapping: Pastel bands identify task families while blue/red callout text labels robot and camera components; photos supply natural colors.

encodings.color: robot/annotation identity and pastel section background
encodings.facet: task examples by embodiment and six lower embodiment cards
encodings.text: task IDs, embodiment names, and colored callout labels

figures.data_and_statistics: The figure is qualitative evidence for six embodiments, more than 120 tasks, and more than 14k rollouts. It contains task/robot photographs and labels, with no measured axis, aggregation, denominator, or uncertainty encoding.
figures.evidence_relation: Provides the concrete experimental substrate for the six-embodiment claim in Figure 1 and the protocol behind Figures 4–7 and Tables 2, 9–13.
design_strengths: The repeated photo framing and labels make morphology and scene diversity easy to scan.
The top task grid connects the setup to actual task names used in the later result tables.
design_weaknesses: The task-photo sample is illustrative and the selection rule is unstated.
Many labels and annotation arrows are small; photographic backgrounds introduce visual noise.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair a compact task grid with one representative scene per experimental embodiment to make a physical evaluation protocol tangible.

figures.label: Figure 12

caption.text: Figure 12. Frame-to-Frame Nearest-neighbor Retrieval between motion and vision codes. In the first column, we select two representative skill actions, grasp and move, and compute their Motion Codes (MC). Columns two through five report the cosine distances between Motion Code (MC) and Vision Code (VC) features and their nearest and farthest neighbors under four settings: Same Embodiment with a Similar Task (SE.ST.), Same Embodiment with a Different Task (SE.DT.), Different Embodiment with a Similar Task (DE.ST.), and Different Embodiment with a Different Task (DE.DT.). For the different-embodiment setting, we use a dual-arm Franka robot. To standardize the notion of left and right across embodiments, we define them with respect to the outward-facing direction of the embodiment.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue headers identify retrieval factors, peach/yellow rows identify actions, and cyan/white dashed boxes highlight motion/vision regions.

encodings.x: retrieval setting from same/similar to different/different
encodings.y: query action row and nearest/farthest result
encodings.shape: image frame with dashed bounding box
encodings.facet: GRASP and MOVE rows crossed with four retrieval settings
encodings.text: MC/VC abbreviations, setting names, action labels, and neighbor labels

figures.data_and_statistics: Qualitative nearest/farthest retrieval; cosine distances motivate the row/column choices, but values are not printed. The surrounding text states seven tasks and ten trajectory episodes per task; no uncertainty is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: Visualizes the semantic-alignment mechanism introduced in Section 4.5 and leads to the task-level procedure in Figure 13 and similarity statistics in Table 18.
design_strengths: Nearest and farthest rows make the intended contrast immediately visible.
The four setting headers expose embodiment/task factors and define the comparison surface.
design_weaknesses: The grid has many tiny labels and repeated screenshots, requiring high-resolution inspection.
The caption is long but still does not give a quantitative retrieval accuracy or tie-breaking rule.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a query column, controlled factor headers, and nearest/farthest rows to make latent-space retrieval inspectable.

For each task, the annotations correspond one-to-one to the four experimental settings in Table 18, representing the actual procedure used to compute nearest-neighbor retrieval across different tasks.

design_strengths: Shared phase columns support one-to-one comparison across four tasks.
The task strips state the factor combination used for each row and reduce ambiguity in the retrieval procedure.
design_weaknesses: The large repeated photos consume space while the actual similarity computation remains implicit.
Task labels and bracketed abbreviations are small and color-dependent.
figures.reusable_pattern: Align latent-retrieval examples by process phase so cross-task comparisons follow a stable temporal grammar.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Dataset Statistics.

tables.uncertainty: Episodes, frames, and sampling weights are point totals; no variance, interval, or repeated-sample uncertainty is reported.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four aggregate sources are listed: OXE 978k episodes/59.3M frames/40%, RoboMIND 69k/21.4M/15%, XR-D 158k/69.1M/35%, and Ego4D 59k/14.3M/10%.
tables.evidence_relation: Summarizes the source mix used in the Stage-1/2 training narrative and points to Figure 8 and Table 8 for fine-grained composition.
design_strengths: Compact four-row layout exposes scale and sampling weight together.
The weight column makes the training mixture explicit.
design_weaknesses: Episodes, frames, and percentages mix units and precision in a very small inset.
The caption gives no unit or definition of the sampling-weight denominator.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair source scale with sampling weight in a compact aggregate table before showing detailed source rows.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2. Success rate results across 20 tasks on Tien Kung 2.0.

tables.uncertainty: Success rates are point percentages from the stated 20 rollouts per task; Avg. is the mean across 20 task columns. No error bars, intervals, or failure-count columns are shown.

design_strengths: Two ten-task header blocks fit 20 tasks while retaining a single method axis.
Average is aligned at the far right for quick comparison.
design_weaknesses: Task names and 22 logical columns force tiny type and two split header blocks.
The caption omits rollout denominator, human-evaluation rule, and the meaning of the trailing separator.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a wide two-level task header and a rightmost average for many-task robot evaluations.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3. Ablation study of XR-1. In Stage-1 and Stage-2, “DT” indicates training directly on the downstream task data.

tables.uncertainty: Point success percentages over six Dual-Arm UR-5e tasks and their average; experiments vary model variant, stage-1/2 data scale, UVMC modality, KL alignment, and Ego4D inclusion. No uncertainty is shown.

tables.evidence_relation: Tests the mechanism interface from Figure 2 and the headline result in Figure 4 by isolating UVMC, data scale, model capacity, and human-video contributions.
design_strengths: The row blocks align protocol changes with the same six task outcomes.
The DT caption key prevents the stage cells from becoming uninterpretable.
design_weaknesses: Several interventions are combined in the same rows, so individual causal contrasts require reading the prose.
Shading is subtle and the caption does not define the highlighted reference rows.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep an ablation matrix on a fixed task panel and group rows by the experimental contrast.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4. Generalization results of XR-1 on unseen scenarios.

tables.uncertainty: Success rates are point percentages under six scenario shifts; the two methods are π0 and XR-1 (ours). The table has no uncertainty or trial-count column.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two top-level task groups (DFR-SweepTrash and DFR-HangCup) organize six shift columns: novel rubbish, novel dustpan, dynamic distractors, background variations, illumination changes, and static distractors. XR-1 is higher in all six cells.
tables.evidence_relation: Quantifies the visual interventions shown in Figure 5 and closes the main robustness claim before the out-of-box charts.
design_strengths: Grouped headers preserve the task context for each shift.
The compact two-row comparison makes direction of change easy to scan.
design_weaknesses: The two rows provide no replication or uncertainty context.
The task grouping and shift labels are dense, and the caption does not state the 20-rollout protocol.
tables.reusable_pattern: Place controlled scenario shifts under task-level grouped headers, then compare the focal method with one strong baseline.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5. Implementation Details of Dual-Branch VQ-VAE.

tables.uncertainty: Hyperparameters and architecture entries are deterministic configuration values: batch size 960, learning rate 1e-4, 0.9B trainable parameters, 256-category/256-dimensional codebook, 13 codes, sequence/interval 50, 275K steps, and named encoder/decoder losses and parameter counts. Uncertainty is not applicable.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two side-by-side three/four-column blocks pair hyperparameters with network architecture type and parameter count; the left and right blocks each have nine visible row slots including dash placeholders.
tables.evidence_relation: Provides reproducibility details for Stage 1 in Figure 2 and the UVMC component tested by Tables 3 and 14.
design_strengths: Side-by-side blocks keep a long configuration list within one page-width table.
Parameter counts and loss types sit beside the named network component.
design_weaknesses: The vertical group labels and dash placeholders consume space while making row correspondence implicit.
Units and meanings of “Code Num.”, “Interval”, and “Params.” are left to prose.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use paired configuration blocks when architecture and optimization settings must be reported together.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6. Implementation Details of XR-1.

tables.uncertainty: XR-1 training configuration includes batch size 640, learning rate 1e-4, AdamW, 13 motion tokens, 13×view_num vision tokens, action sequence 50, and 300k steps; architecture entries include 18-layer decoders, 2048/1024 hidden dimensions, 8 heads, and flow matching. design_strengths: The parameter/value pairing is easy to scan.

design_weaknesses: The table does not state whether values are shared across stages.

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8. Pretraining Dataset Details.

design_strengths: The group separators and bold aggregate rows make the source hierarchy recoverable.

design_weaknesses: The 63-row continuation is difficult to navigate and lacks repeated group labels at the top of page 20.
Mixed units and precision prevent quick numeric comparison across rows.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a continued source table with bold aggregates and consistent numeric columns for a heterogeneous pretraining mixture.

caption.text: Table 17. Comparison of XR-1 with baselines on CALVIN D→D.

tables.uncertainty: Each cell is a point completion probability for the 1–5 subtask horizon; Success Rate is the sum across five columns. The table reports no confidence interval, seed variation, or count in the table.

tables.label: Table 19

caption.text: Table 19. The tasks summary of our real-world experiments.

tables.uncertainty: Trajectory Num. and Avg. Len. are point metadata for each listed task; there are no performance estimates or uncertainty columns. The PDF contains 123 task rows across six embodiment groups (21 Dual-Arm UR5e, 22 Tien Kung 2.0, 20 Tien Kung 1.0, 20 Dual-Arm Franka, 20 AgileX Cobot Magic V2.0, and 20 Single-Arm UR5e), despite the reading purpose/main prose often referring to 120 or “more than 120” tasks.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns are #, Task, Trajectory Num., Avg. Len., Task Instruction, and Task Setting. The table continues from page 33 through page 45; group headings mark six embodiments and each row gives a task code, trajectory count, average length, instruction, and setting.
tables.evidence_relation: Completes the physical benchmark specification behind Figure 3, the result matrices, and Figure 18’s representative task strips; it is the replication endpoint for task identity and data volume.
design_strengths: The repeated header and grouped embodiment headings support a long continuation table.
Instruction text keeps the task semantics alongside counts and average lengths.
design_weaknesses: The continuation spans 13 pages and task numbering restarts within groups, increasing navigation cost.
The 123-row PDF inventory conflicts with the “120 tasks” shorthand used elsewhere, and the caption gives no definition of trajectory length.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a continuation table with grouped embodiment sections and full language instructions when a physical benchmark must be reproducible.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: 视觉叙事从 Figure 1 的数据—框架—embodiment—评测总览开始，经 Figure 2 的 UVMC 三阶段接口和 Figure 3 的六机器人设置，进入 Figures 4、6、7 的主比较、out-of-box 与 fast adaptation 结果；Table 1–4 回收数据配方、任务结果、消融和 unseen-scenario robustness。附录 Figure 8/Table 8 细化预训练源，Tables 9–16 展开各 embodiment 与 ablation，Figures 9–10 镜像主结果，Figure 11/Table 17 覆盖 CALVIN，Figures 12–15/Table 18 检验 UVMC 语义对齐，Figures 16–18/Table 19 收束失败边界与完整任务复现。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure/Table 标签和编号按 PDF 顺序置于对象下方；主文 caption 多数说明设置与比较对象，Figure 1、2、7、8、12、13 包含机制或协议定义。结果 caption 很少直接陈述优胜结论或不确定性，Figure 10 保留 PDF 中的 “adaption” 和 “In this setup, Here,”，Figure 18 caption 列出六类但图面显示七个任务条带。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 结果矩阵使用 Method/Exp. 左侧主键、任务列和 Avg. 右侧汇总；20-task 表采用两组十任务表头。消融表把 stage、codebook/token 与任务结果放在同一行；配置表采用两侧 Hyperparameter/Value block；Table 8/19 用数据字段和分组标题支撑复现。百分比、概率、计数和长度共用相似数字字形，但单位/分母并未统一写入表头。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 的三阶段/UVMC 信息流由 Table 3 的阶段与 DT 对照、Table 14 的 codebook/token 对照、Table 15 的 Ego4D 对照和 Table 16 的 cross-embodiment 对照逐项检验。Figure 4/6/7 的主结果由 Tables 2、4、9–13 以 task-level 数值回收；Figure 14/15 与 Table 18 将 UVMC 语义对齐从定性嵌入延伸到相似度统计。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figure 1–7 与 Table 1–4 建立方法和核心实验链；Figure 8/Table 8 补足数据构成，Tables 5–7 补足实现配置。附录 Figures 9–10 重复 out-of-box/fast-adaptation 语法，Figures 11–15 与 Tables 17–18 支撑 simulation/retrieval/t-SNE，Figures 16–18 与 Table 19 公开失败样例、任务类别和完整指令。Table 19 的 PDF 行数为 123，提供比正文“120 tasks” shorthand 更具体的对象边界。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文与表格以 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 为主，图内导出资产还使用 Calibri、DejaVu Sans、Times New Roman 和 Nimbus Mono；图/表估计字号约 5.5–8 pt，Figure 1/2 的大标题可达 18–24 pt。粗体用于方法、表头和 focal row，斜体多用于公式/caption；跨对象层级稳定，字族和小字号不完全一致。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 结果图在 Figures 4、6、7、9、10 与 Figure 1 radar 中重复 XR-1 橙色及 hatch，基线色顺序总体稳定；Table 2–4、9–16 的淡蓝表头和粗体行形成第二套编码。阶段/定性图使用蓝、桃、绿、黄背景，t-SNE/检索图使用任务色。语义重复来自图例、标签、hatch、表头和分面，但自然照片及细粒度任务色仍有灰度与色盲风险。

most_reusable_patterns: 以 Figure 2 的阶段化信息流把离散表示、训练阶段和部署输出放在同一页宽接口中。
以 Figures 4、6、7、9、10 的固定方法色、直接数值标注和 Average 分隔线承载多任务比较。
以 Figure 12/13 的 factor-header retrieval grid 和 Figure 14/15 的 scatter-plus-callout 组合把抽象表示连接到具体动作帧。
以 Table 19 的 embodiment 分组、完整语言指令和 trajectory metadata 建立可复现任务字典。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：最清楚地呈现 UVMC 与三阶段训练的接口。
Figure 4 + Table 13：主任务比较和数值回收形成紧密证据对。
Figure 8 + Table 8：预训练数据规模、来源和 embodiment 构成互补。
Figure 16–18 + Table 19：把失败边界、任务设置和完整实验清单连接起来。
failure_patterns: 结果图与 20-task 表的横向密度导致任务标签和数值依赖放大查看。
多数 caption 只说明设置，未在对象层面定义分母、误差、失败值或 focal finding。
定性图大量使用自然照片、细小文字和彩色框，灰度与色盲可读性有限。
Table 8/19 的跨页延续和对象边界暴露了计数 shorthand 与 PDF 实际行数/类别数的差异。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: XR-1 以阶段化框架图建立 UVMC 接口，再用固定方法色的多任务结果矩阵、跨 embodiment 定性网格和附录复现表把泛化、机制、失败边界与任务清单串成一条证据链。
